subject: Quick thought on Dental Smiles and local search
body: Hi Dental Smiles team, I recently came across your practice while looking at local dental providers in Austin, TX. I really appreciate your patient-centric, compassionate approach to family and cosmetic dentistry, especially your work with preventive care and dental implants. While browsing your current site at mydentalsmiles.com, I noticed a couple of opportunities to help more local patients connect with you. Specifically, adding a direct click-to-call button in the mobile header and updating your local business schema markup could make it much easier for patients on-the-go to book an appointment and improve your visibility in local search results. I went ahead and built a clean, modern live prototype for you to show how these adjustments look in practice. You can check it out here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644ca061ab0364d-0xa1253d5b85da5cd.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added direct click-to-call phone buttons in the mobile header
Enhanced local business schema markup for better local search visibility
